newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - DAILY VARIETY - AUG 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - DAILY VARIETY - AUG 7.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Thursday's Daily Variety:
* Westinghouse CBS is expected to announce that CBS Entertainment president Leslie Moonves has been promoted, and will assume many of the duties formerly handled by Peter Lund.
* The fall movie season will see a release schedule so crowded that four new films a week will be the norm and six the extreme.
* Continental Cablevision founder and CEO Amos Hostetter on Wednesday quit MediaOne, after a disagreement with the cabler's new owner US West Media Group.
* President Clinton on Wednesday officially tapped William Kennard to replace Reed Hundt as FCC chairman.
* Universal Latin America has inked a joint-venture pact with producer Gustavo Santoalalla to launch Surco Records.
* Former Columbia TriStar Motion Picture Co chairman Mark Canton is returning to Warner Bros as a producer.
* Microsoft will invest $150 million in Apple Computer.
